name: Rock waterfall
description: A small waterfall about 3 m high: a stream runs between stacked grey rocks, spills over a jutting mossy lip stone and falls as a pale sheet with foam streaks into a dark pool ringed by rim stones, moss on every ledge.

provenance.prompt: A small cascade spilling over a mossy rock step into a basin, about 1.5 × 1 × 3 m; anchors water:spout and water:basin with sizes.
